image_description: A landscape photograph featuring a herd of bison grazing in a grassy valley with a winding river. Several bison are visible in the foreground and mid-ground, displaying characteristic dark brown shaggy fur, shoulder humps, and large heads. The background consists of rolling hills and sparse vegetation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible on multiple foreground subjects; heads are proportionally large and broad, horns are short and curved as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinctive hanging fur (beard) is clearly visible on the chins of the foreground bison.
Resolution and distance prevent clear visualization of eye color/details on any subject.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick head fur, consistent with species traits.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Subjects exhibit the characteristic massive build and height at the shoulders relative to the hindquarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder hump is the most defining feature and is clearly present and covered in shaggy dark fur on all visible adults.
Visual contrast between the dense mane/hump fur and the smoother, shorter hair on the rear flanks is evident.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Horns are visibly small relative to the massive bulk of the head and body.
Legs are partially obscured by tall grass in the foreground and too distant in the background to resolve hoof structure (cloven vs. solid).
Tails are visible on several subjects, appearing short with a distinct darker tuft at the end.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subjects are indeed bison and not misclassified bovids (e.g., cattle or muskox).
Verify anatomical correctness of limbs and body structure for the clearest subjects in the foreground.
Assess overall image coherence, texture consistency of fur, and check for subtle AI-generation artifacts like blending errors.
Ensure the spatial relationship between the herd, the river, and the hills is physically consistent and free from depth warping.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency and edge definition against the background
Anatomical symmetry of the shoulder hump and head
Leg count and placement visibility through grass occlusion
Background coherence (river banks and horizon line)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'legs' checkpoint. While marked untestable due to grass, check if any legs appear to merge into the ground or have impossible joint angles. Verify if the 'shaggy' texture of the fur looks naturally generated or if it exhibits repetitive pattern artifacts common in AI generation.
